cuttingFilesTab.title: Map cutting files (.pdf) to orders
cuttingFilesTab.description: Paste or upload a list of Google Drive links — one link per line. File name format <code1>XX-XXXXX-XXXXX-*.pdf</code1> (2 letters + 5 digits + 5 digits, e.g. <code2>BH-96341-30608-*.pdf</code2>). The system fetches the file name from Drive (needs to be shared "anyone with link") → parses productionId → matches the order.
